tytul: Pattypan squash in tomato sauce: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for pattypan squash, a summer squash, in tomato sauce, canned in jars.

ostrzezenia.tekst: Pressure canning is the only recommended method for canning meat, poultry, seafood and vegetables; using a boiling-water bath for these foods poses a real risk of botulism poisoning.
Canning summer squash without pickling is not recommended, because there is uncertainty about how to determine adequate processing times.

akapity: Most mixtures of low-acid and acid foods are also low-acid, unless the recipe has enough lemon juice, citric acid or vinegar to make them acid foods.
JarAtlas does not treat a dish as an acid food because it tastes sour, or because acid was added without a tested recipe.
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for canned pattypan squash in tomato sauce from a checked source.
